title: Michael Mayhem - Programer Art
description: A resourcepack for Michael Mayhem that makes the textures look more like the programmer art style.
body:
# Michael Mayhem, but it has the old texure style?!!


Yes, exactly as it says. This resourcepack makes the textures from the Michael Mayhem mod look more like the classic Minecraft artstyle.

This was made due to recent complains resurging about Jappa's work, and me kind of agreeing with them.

Now don't get me wrong, I abslutely love the new Minecraft textures. I think they look a lot better than the old ones. In fact, I made the entirety of Michael Mayhem with that style.

..HOWEVER, I can't help but agree that it's just shitty corporate garbage with no STYLE.

(My textures in Michael Mayhem actually have style though, because I also developed the mod and know what things are supposed to look like, unlike Jappa who is specifically hired to do textures.. but just trust me on this one ok gang.)

(Like seriously I don't even agree with this, like yea it's supposed to look uniform gang that's the whole point. These are video esay buzzwords. However, I feel drawn to this stuff like the green goblin mask. I think I have a massive problem. Maybe it's just a little bit of human nature. How am I supposed to get rid of something like that? Oh wait, you don't! ...lmao)
I'm calling Paul to come deal with this.


-----

**DISCLAIMER:** Not every texture was done at the moment! More will be done as time goes on.
